Overview of Basque Country Region (País Vasco / Euskadi)

Basque Country Region (País Vasco / Euskadi) is located in the Basque Country region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Vitoria-Gasteiz. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include San Sebastián La Concha Bay & Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Guggenheim Museum Bilbao & Casco Viejo, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe & Getaria, Vitoria-Gasteiz medieval quarter.

RegionBasque Country
Capital cityVitoria-Gasteiz
Cities & municipalities33
Primary transport hubVitoria-Gasteiz Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Basque Country Region

Bilbao Airport (BIO) and San Sebastián; Renfe Alvia trains and Euskotren coastal line between Bilbao and Donostia. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Basque Country

When visiting cities across Basque Country, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Pintxos (Gilda, txangurro, tortilla)
  • Txuleta (charcoal-grilled ribeye)
  • Bacalao al pil-pil
  • Basque burnt cheesecake (La Viña style)
  • Txakoli & Rioja Alavesa wines

Best time to visit Basque Country

Best time to visit Basque Country: May–Oct.
